title: Radzi Lone Villagers
description: This mod adds structures for all villager professions
body:
> **Beta**  
> Early release. Worldgen, placement, and loot may change.  

**Radzi Lone Villagers** adds 13 structures to the world (one per villager profession, for now). Each can be found in the wilderness, placed away from vanilla villages. Structures have:

- Villagers to trade with
- Custom placed items you can click to pick up
- Chests, barrels, and armor stands with loot

## Placement

The mod has custom experimental terrain checks for detecting bad spots. Other structure mods like **Lithostitched** can conflict with it. If something breaks, please report it on [Discord](https://discord.gg/y4CZbRqsPg).

## FAQ

**Will this mod be available for other mod launchers?**

Yes - Fabric only for now. Forge, NeoForge, and datapacks are planned for the 1.0.0 release.

**Can I use this in my modpack?**

Yes - but waiting for 1.0.0 is a good idea while the mod is in beta.

**Can … be done or improved?**

All ideas are welcome. Hop on [Discord](https://discord.gg/y4CZbRqsPg).
